# Clean Sweep Rubbish Removals

> Rubbish removal across Sydney, NSW. Household, garden, reno and office
> clean-outs, move-outs and deceased estates. Fully insured. We do all the
> lifting and loading, and sweep up after. ABN 55 989 268 862.

## What we do
- Household rubbish and furniture removal
- Garden and green waste
- Reno and building waste
- Office and commercial clean-outs
- Move-outs and end of lease
- Deceased estates
- Wheelie bin collection

## Prices (2026, AUD)
- Wheelie bin collection: $50 per standard wheelie bin
- The Big Sweep (kerbside pile): $400
- 1/4 trailer load (about 4 m3): $550
- 1/2 trailer load (about 8 m3): $950
- 3/4 trailer load (about 12 m3): $1,350
- Full trailer load (about 16 m3, 4 x 2 x 2 m dual-axle cage trailer): $1,750
- Extras: mattress +$120 each, gas bottle +$30 each
- Garden waste only: 20% off
- Heavy waste (bricks, concrete, tiles) and stairs or long carries: priced on site
- Final price is confirmed on site before loading starts

## What we take
Furniture, whitegoods, e-waste, paint and oil, gas bottles, fire extinguishers,
mattresses, garden waste, reno waste and general household rubbish.

## What we can't take
Tyres, asbestos, fibro board, hazardous chemicals, soil or dirt.

## Booking and payment
- Book online at https://cleansweeprubbishremovals.netlify.app/#quote
- Preferred collection times from 10am to 4pm
- Pay a $100 deposit or the full price online (card, Apple Pay, Google Pay or
  direct debit through Stripe). Any balance is settled on the day.
- Cancellations less than 24 hours before collection are non-refundable.

## Where we work
Sydney, New South Wales, Australia.
